title: Battle of Wofla
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Wofla", at revision 1370594387, opens: "The Battle of Wofla was fought on August 28, 1542, near Lake Ashenge in Wofla (Ofla) between the Portuguese under Cristóvão da Gama and the forces of Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi. Reinforced with a superiority not only in numbers but in firearms, Imam Ahmad was victorious and forced the Portuguese, along with Queen Seble Wongel and her retinue, to flee their fortified encampment and leave their weapons behind." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q835180, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1542 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
